name: EDEN IV
source:
Remnants of rockets drifting near Mars are discovered in 2070 AD. Investigation reveals that materials belong to the rocket from moon base attacked by aliens in 2067. Among the investigation team is planet geologist Ellen Marvell. No one noticed Glen Collins lurking inside the recovered rocket...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元2070年，人们在火星附近发现了漂浮的火箭残骸。调查显示，这些材料属于2067年遭外星人袭击的月球基地所发射的火箭。行星地质学家Ellen Marvell也是调查队成员之一。没有人注意到，Glen Collins正潜伏在打捞回来的火箭内部…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
